note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are parsed as an in-memory frame, creating the schunk object that carries attacker-controlled metadata.
The frame parser reads per-chunk header fields from the input and derives the chunk size used later by decompression.
The implementation should reject inconsistent chunk sizes across the frame; instead it only zeroes the size after detecting a mismatch, leaving later consumers with an unsafe size state.

code: dsize = blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk(schunk, nchunk, uncompressed_data + i, schunk->chunksize);
note: The decompressor uses the parsed chunk size as the output size argument, so a bad frame-derived size reaches the target operation.
